dedupe_keys.name: eia europe brent spot price fob history

description: The EIA Europe Brent series publishes free-on-board crude-oil spot prices in dollars per barrel. The provider page offers daily history and controls for weekly, monthly and annual views, with a linked XLS export. Coverage begins in 1987; a separately linked Kaggle mirror describes a snapshot ending in November 2022 and must not be treated as the current source. EIA public data are available without charge as United States government works. A limitation is that a benchmark commodity price is neither a delivered local fuel price nor an observation of physical infrastructure capacity. Simulation uses include historical oil-price inputs and sensitivity scenarios for fuel-supply or infrastructure investment models. It complements data-eia-petroleum-supply-and-prices, whose parent description covers spot prices generally but does not explicitly identify this named series. Only the provider page identity, units and access controls were checked; no price file or numerical time-series analysis was downloaded.
